remarks: Currently configured as a 2-family home, this property offers the unique opportunity to convert and expand into a spacious single-family residence with ease. First floor features 2 bedrooms, full bath, generous eat-in kitchen with pantry, living room, and home office - perfect for today's flexible lifestyle. Upstairs, you'll find an additional bedroom, full bath, living room, and large eat-in kitchen with pantry and tons of storage. Hardwood floors throughout. Extra large, one-car attached garage leads directly to a spacious basement complete with half bath, offering even more room for storage, recreation, or future expansion. Enjoy relaxing on the inviting front porch or entertain in the beautiful, level backyard. Located in a desirable neighborhood on a quiet, dead end cul-de-sac, close to top-rated schools, and just minutes from Byram Park, pool, and marina. With a current living space of 1,485 sq ft and a total FAR of approximately 3,000 sq ft, there's plenty of opportunity to expand and truly make this your dream home. Don't miss this chance to bring your vision to life in Greenwich! Being Sold As Is.
